entries.047ed6a108aeed09: The company's main operating base is Akita Prefecture, and it provides financial services to individual customers, corporate customers such as small and medium-sized enterprises, and national and local governments.
entries.254202e16c1d55c6: Based in Akita Prefecture, its main operating base, the company has a branch network of 98 locations in total, comprising its head office, 96 branches and one sub-branch. In its analysis of operating results, the company explains that loans grew through increases in personal loans, lending to businesses, and lending to national and local governments, and that deposits (including negotiable deposits) also grew, driven by increases in both personal and corporate deposits. It also provides support for solving issues by using non-financial functions, such as expanding sales channels through the regional trading company Uta no Kuni Akita Co., Ltd. and a job-hunting website specialized in employment within Akita Prefecture.

entries.cbd62e8587d494bb: The business model is a community-based financial institution model in which funds collected through deposits are invested in loans and securities, and income is also earned from fees on service transactions such as exchange, as well as from the income of group companies such as leasing, guarantees and credit cards.
entries.dbdfc61ba360abb9: The company's management philosophy is "Regional Coexistence," and under the Akita Bank Group VISION "Creating value. Connecting to the future," looking ahead to 2030, it states that it will continue to take on the challenge of realizing a rich region over the long term by solving regional issues and providing high-quality financial and non-financial services that meet customers' needs. The three-year medium-term management plan (fiscal 2025 to 2027), which started in April 2025, is positioned as the second phase toward realizing the Group VISION, and the company states that it will work on measures based on three basic policies: establishing a value co-creation business model, refining regional resources and increasing their added value, and enhancing human capital. The numerical targets of the plan concern future matters and are not transcribed here.
